h1: Care, support and training, with the expert in your eyeline.
lede: SmartCare is an AR smart glass solution for telepresence, remote support, EMR collaboration and training, with real-time captioning and translation. A clinician or technician wears the glasses; specialists, records and instructions appear in view while hands stay on the task.

blocks.eyebrow: SmartCare on the Smart Solutions Platform
blocks.title: Telepresence · Captioning · Translation
blocks.body: Telepresence for ward rounds and field visits, remote specialist support, EMR access in the eyeline and recorded training sessions, with every conversation captioned and translated in real time.

items.label: records, experts and instructions in the eyeline

blocks.text: AR-powered solutions designed to improve efficiency across industries

SmartCare is one of four solutions on the Smart Solutions Platform from Purview Technologies, the group’s AI and XR company. The platform puts AR smart glasses, real-time captioning and translation, and Purview’s vision and voice AI into the hands of frontline teams, so the people doing the work see what they need, hands free, and the people supporting them can be anywhere.

items.title: Telepresence
items.body: Specialists join a ward round, home visit or site call through the wearer’s view, in real time.

items.title: Remote support
items.body: Experts see what the wearer sees, annotate the view and guide the next step.

items.title: EMR collaboration
items.body: Patient records and care plans surfaced hands free, with secure role-based access.

items.title: Training
items.body: Procedures recorded first-person for teaching, review and competency sign-off.

items.title: Real-time captioning
items.body: Speech captioned in the wearer’s view for noisy settings and hearing accessibility.

items.title: Translation
items.body: Multilingual conversations translated live between staff, patients and families.

blocks.text: From glasses on to value out

items.title: Equip
items.body: AR smart glasses issued to frontline staff and paired to the SmartCare platform.

items.title: Connect
items.body: Specialists, records systems and training libraries linked with secure access.

items.title: Work
items.body: Wearer calls an expert or opens a record by voice; captions and translation run throughout.

items.title: Record
items.body: Sessions captured for training, audit and quality review where permitted.

items.title: Improve
items.body: Usage and outcome data inform protocols and training.

items.title: One platform, enterprise-grade
items.body: Purview Technologies supplies and supports the AR glasses, runs the SmartCare platform with its captioning and translation engines, and integrates with EMR, video and identity systems under healthcare-grade security.

items.q: Is it secure for patient data?
items.a: SmartCare is built for healthcare-grade security with role-based access and integration to existing EMR and identity systems.

items.q: Does it work in other languages?
items.a: Yes. Captioning and translation run in real time across supported languages.
